AdversarialVerify.reason: The generated workers and independently exercised headed-Chrome lifecycle now satisfy the functional contract, and every original browser finding remains fixed. However, the explicitly required shipped command BROWSER_HEADED=true bun run check:browser-runtime failed on its single permitted run with 'First service worker install timed out'. Reliable completion of that gate is mandatory, so the branch cannot be confirmed.

console.first_install: activated; existing tab uncontrolled; zero controllerchange
console.session_ended: activated v3; exactly one additional controllerchange
console.cold_restart: latest v3 controller and sole v3 cache retained

stage.first_install: activated; existing tab uncontrolled; zero controllerchange
stage.session_ended: activated v3; exactly one additional controllerchange
stage.cold_restart: latest v3 controller and sole v3 cache retained

independent_headed_lifecycle.waiting_method: updatefound and ServiceWorker statechange exact events with bounded failure deadlines; no polling, networkidle, or sleeps

required_shipped_runtime_command.failure: page.evaluate: Error: First service worker install timed out
required_shipped_runtime_command.required_fix: Make the first-install lifecycle assertion await the active worker's exact statechange to activated without racing the readiness transition, then rerun the command once under the same deadline.

original_five_findings.cold_offline_hashed_assets: pass: Console and Stage rendered nonblank after HTTP-cache clear, origin shutdown and cold Chrome restart; hashed JS and CSS returned 200 from service workers
original_five_findings.stale_foreign_cache: pass: foreign canary never rendered; navigation stayed network-first and fallback app-scoped
original_five_findings.frame_policy: pass: response frame-ancestors header present and evil.localhost iframe rejected
original_five_findings.reduced_motion: pass: every computed duration and delay <=1ms; .ui-reveal=1ms
original_five_findings.stage_overflow: pass: landing and display at 1440x900, 768x900, 320x800 and 720x450 plus physical fullscreen had document dimensions bounded to viewport and no clipped required control

commands.result: functional pass after exact lifecycle superseded two premature activating-state observations

safe_cherry_pick.note: The three commits are dependency-ordered and functionally correct, but the complete series is not acceptance-safe until the shipped headed runtime command passes.
